Log.md-6-* Service worker logs (especially useful when debugging [[Sync]] issues):
Log.md-7-  * In Chromium-based browsers these logs are mixed with the regular JavaScript console.
Log.md:8:  * In Firefox start at `about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox` then find it under the Service Worker section and click “Inspect”.
Log.md-9-  * In Safari they can be accessed via `Developer > Service workers`.
Log.md-10-* Server logs: Server logs are written to the standard output of the server process.

CHANGELOG.md-320-* Fix: symlinks inside the space directory are no longer accidentally removed when cleaning up empty parent directories after a file delete.
CHANGELOG.md-321-* Fix: slash commands now resolve the syntax node ending at the cursor, so they no longer get incorrectly suppressed adjacent to comment blocks or links.
CHANGELOG.md:322:* Fix: [Service Worker is now built without `import` statements](https://github.com/silverbulletmd/silverbullet/pull/1949) so it loads on Firefox versions before 147 (by [Carlos Fdez. Llamas](https://github.com/sirikon)).
